fields.label: ground truth: source_train and validation only for fitting/selection; target labels only for final evaluation
fields.text: class-free automatic description of the same image
fields.text_embedding: frozen SigLIP 2 encoding of text field
fields.numeric: 19 direct color, brightness, contrast, edge and geometry statistics of one image

join_rule: exact dataset and id equality; no nearest-time join
time_rule: none: Office-Home and Digits contain no repeated time-stamped observations
leakage_rule: target_adapt, test, new_slice and external ground-truth labels excluded from normalization, fitting, checkpoint and scheme selection
missing_policy: reject absent image or text for extraction; evaluate missing-modality masks on a fitted fusion head
integrity: feature id order equals row id order; groups do not intersect splits
